title: A product counterexample to the simplex maximum for projection-body volume
summary: The product of two ten-dimensional simplices has larger normalized projection-body volume than a twenty-dimensional simplex. This gives a counterexample to Brannen's proposed simplex maximum.
family_title: Sharp projection-body inequalities and a counterexample to simplex maximization

review.reason: Gives a product-of-simplices counterexample to a proposed simplex maximum for projection bodies.
